text:
Anna: Heads up — PMs want to ship a new packaging called ScalePlus next month. It effectively doubles monthly compute quota for Standard customers and adds 10k burst credits/account. Need a quick GPU headroom estimate + cost delta by EOD Friday. @Mike @Jun can you run a sim? Also flag regional constraints and any fast mitigations.

Mike: Do we have an adoption curve from PMs? need that to model ramp.

Priya: (PM) conservative rollout plan: 10% week1, 30% week2, 60% by week5, 85% by week10. Expect many small apps to use burst credits early.

Jun: OK — what historical metrics should we anchor on? suggest p95 tokens/s, concurrent reqs, and GPU-hours/day by tier + region. I'll pull Prometheus queries.

Sam: I'll sketch the simulation approach: adoption curve + per-customer consumption distribution (heavy tail). Poisson arrivals for new requests, power-law for per-app qps. Quick baseline numbers from last quarter: avg fleet GPU-hours/day = 1400, p95 = 2100; Standard tier ~40% of total.

Jun: PromQL snippets I'll run: 
```promql
sum(rate(gpu_consumption_hours[1h])) by (region)
sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (customer_tier)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(response_time_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
From an earlier pull: Standard current = ~560 GPU-hours/day, peak ~960 on spike days. If ScalePlus doubles per-account monthly quotas and burst credits are heavily used, sticky usage could increase between +20% and +60% depending on burst behavior.

Pradeep: Finance quick calc: on-demand GPU cost ~\$3.50/hr (A100-ish). If we see +200 GPU-hours/day => +6k GPU-hours/month => ~\$21k/month on-demand; reserved commit could be ~\$12k/month (rough). Will model more precisely.

Mike: @ops-bot capacity check please.

ops-bot: Current reserved capacity: us-west-2=120 GPUs, eu-west-1=80 GPUs, ap-southeast-1=40 GPUs. Available unreserved (on-demand): us-west-2=60, eu-west-1=20, ap-southeast-1=30.

Sam: Region note — eu-west-1 is tight. If rollout causes >50% of EU Standard customers to use bursts simultaneously, we risk local queueing / fallbacks. Recommend soft region caps for burst credits or automatic spill to us-west.

Anna: Actionables: 1) Jun/Sam build sim using the PM adoption ramps + heavy-tail per-app consumption; 2) return incremental GPU-hours/day by region + cost delta (on-demand vs reserved); 3) propose temporary per-customer burst throttles (e.g., burst credits expire in 30d) and region caps; 4) PR with reservation ask if >150 GPUs needed.

Jun: Will have first-pass numbers by Friday noon. Quick back-of-envelope: global +30% GPU-hours -> ~250 extra GPUs sustained to cover peaks; if bursts are used aggressively, short windows could require +350-420 GPUs.

Priya: We can stagger EU rollouts if needed — prefer taper vs global flip.

Mike: If we need reservations, what is procurement lead time? cloud ops?

Sam: For reserved instances / committed capacity on cloud: 4-6 weeks ordering + provisioning. For Dedicated racks/hardware, plan 6-8 weeks. Short-term options: cross-region spill and soft throttles.

Pradeep: Billing note: reserved capacity is sunk if unused; propose a mixed strategy (partial commit + on-demand). I'll model three scenarios (conservative/expected/aggressive) and present cost curves.

Anna: Also include sensitivity to rate-limit config: if we increase per-customer sustained limit by 2x, how much more sustained capacity is required?

Jun: Will include both: (A) same sustained limits but larger burst credits, (B) doubled sustained limits. Early sims show doubling sustained limits can increase sustained GPU demand by +15-45% depending on heavy-tail weight.

Sam: Canary plan suggestion: enable ScalePlus for 5% of accounts in EU -> monitor 10 days -> proceed if p95 GPU-hours < +15%. Need a canary-specific rate-limit policy.

Anna: Good. Please include region-level headroom table and cost sensitivity in the Friday update. If numbers show >150 GPUs needed, we'll prepare a reservation ask. :thumbsup:

Jun: small rate-limit config example I'll test in sim: 
```json
{
  "tier":"Standard",
  "sustained_rps":"50",
  "burst_rps":"500",
  "burst_credits":"10000",
  "burst_window_s":"3600"
}
```

Pradeep: I'll validate the cost per GPU-hour and run the 3-scenario model.

Mike: Thanks — ping this thread when you have the numbers.

Anna: Thanks all — Jun/Sam assigned.

Sam: Will post simulation artifacts (notebooks + graphs) to the thread when done.

Jun: ETA Friday noon.

Priya: We'll hold the public rollout until infra signs off on capacity plan.

Anna: Closing loop — will schedule a short sync after Friday's numbers.
